name: mirai-mcp
description: Affordable Mirai chat completions for AI agents: call models, read live pricing, check quota.
long_description:
Mirai is a cheap model backend for Hermes, OpenClaw, and other agent harnesses. This stdio MCP server wraps the public Mirai HTTP API.

Without MIRAI_API_KEY, guest daily quota on /publik/chat may work until it runs out. With a key, calls use the OpenAI compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint.

Create a free key via https://satuapps.com/docs. The process starts and advertises tools even when MIRAI_API_KEY is unset.

MIRAI_API_KEY.title: MIRAI_API_KEY
MIRAI_API_KEY.description: Optional for discovery. Required for paid API calls after guest quota. Create a free key via satuapps.com/docs. Never commit the value.

MIRAI_BASE_URL.title: MIRAI_BASE_URL
MIRAI_BASE_URL.description: Optional. API base URL. Leave empty to use Mirai production.

tools.name: call_model
tools.description: Send chat messages to Mirai and return the assistant reply.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List models with live per million token pricing from GET /harga.

tools.name: account_status
tools.description: Guest quota or paid balance and subscription windows.
